instruction: Turn on the minimal view mode in VLC's interface preferences

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's minimal view mode. The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_minimal_view function to verify if 'qt-minimal-view' in vlcrc is set to '1' (enabled).
